scientific_choices.rationale: The earlier 100-epoch run retained only its best checkpoint at epoch 71; both controlled branches restore identical model, optimizer, and RNG states from that checkpoint and train epochs 72-500. They do not claim to continue from epoch 100.
One predeclared moderate increase from weight 3 to 5 tests stronger false-positive cost on valid inter-word separator pixels. No TEST data or threshold sweep selected this value.

Two isolated training processes share one RTX 3090, with a free-VRAM preflight and per-process peak-memory reporting. Outputs may remain nondeterministic across process scheduling despite deterministic operators.
